detail.longDescription: Ultra Talking Pulse 2.0 is out: a free, open-source Android app that measures pulse, breathing and now heart rate variability with the front camera, and talks you into position. New: a 2-minute guided breathing exercise you can follow with your eyes closed, an optional AI explanation of your results (only numbers leave the phone), and a phone check. Wellness only, not a medical device. Drafted with AI assistance. https:// dev.to/demirajvazi10max/ultra- talking-pulse-20-hrv-guided-breathing-and-an-ai-that-explains-your-numbers-489n # Accessibility # a11y # Android # OpenSource
